name: Hurricane, quick look, 8 km
line: CM1's hurricane case run with GM1's own physics choices, not CM1's stock hurricane: a weak swirl over warm ocean grows into a hurricane over four days of storm time.
note: This is CM1's hurricane case run with GM1's physics choices, not CM1's stock hurricane: an even 8 km grid over 1024 km in place of CM1's stretched one, GM1's turbulence scheme in place of a boundary layer scheme, a constant ocean drag, and 250 cloud droplets per cubic centimetre. What you will see: rain cells form around the swirl from about hour 6 and the swirl looks ragged for the first day, then tightens; the eye is clear by hour 48. GM1's run of this preset on an RTX 4090 with ArWen 2.8.9 (gpuwm 2.8.9), on a fixed 7.5 s time step, is compared with a CM1 r21.1 run with the same changed settings but its own adaptive time step (from 10 s, as CM1's file has it). Through hour 54 the two stay within about 6 hPa and 7 m/s ground-relative at the lowest level. GM1 reaches 951.2 hPa at hour 90, with its fastest wind, 62.9 m/s ground-relative, at hour 93; CM1 reaches 954.9 hPa and 62.0 m/s ground-relative at hour 81. GM1's storm holds near its peak after it: 954.0 hPa and 58.8 m/s ground-relative at hour 96; CM1's storm weakens after it: 971.7 hPa and 50.7 m/s ground-relative at hour 96 (all measured). The time step is a fixed 7.5 s where CM1's file has one that changes with the storm. With CM1's own adaptive setting GM1's hurricane stops early or makes a much weaker storm, a known issue: 8 km runs on it stopped at hour 20.8 and at hour 29.1, and the one that ran to the end reached 995 hPa and 35 m/s ground-relative where CM1 reaches 955 hPa and 62 m/s ground-relative (measured with ArWen 2.8.0 (gpuwm 2.8.0)).

floors_why: A hurricane is not made smaller than 1000 km across, because its starting swirl is 500 km in radius, or shorter than 3 days, because its eye is not clear before the end of the second day.

eye_forms.basis: GM1's run of this preset on an RTX 4090 with ArWen 2.8.9 (gpuwm 2.8.9) has a clear eye and eyewall by hour 48, as a CM1 r21.1 run with the same changed settings but its own adaptive time step (from 10 s, as CM1's file has it) has (both measured)
